Every button on the site.

Each page’s buttons and button links, by page, in the order they appear on it. The buttons under “Made beside what they act on” appear only when there is something for them, such as Merge beside a green pull request on the control panel. The build reads them from the pages themselves, so a new button is listed here once its page goes live. This copy was written 2026-10-18 16:25 UTC.
